category_title: Individuals with multiply controlled SIB partially identified in initial assessments
minimal_context: The student is in a padded treatment room with access to moderately preferred toys while the therapist sits nearby reading a magazine.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Here are some toys for you to play with. I am going to sit over here and read my magazine now.

STUDENT: (Wearing a helmet, she ignores the toys and begins hitting and kicking her torso and legs.)

TUTOR: Keep playing with your toys.

STUDENT: (Stops kicking and begins scratching and pinching the skin on her arms.)

TUTOR: We need to have quiet time right now.

STUDENT: (Rapidly escalates to hitting herself in the head and repeatedly banging her head against the surface of the padded treatment room.)

options.A: Provide follow-in talk that is directly related to the student's ongoing actions with the toys across all conditions and for the entirety of each session.
options.B: Use psychometric assessments to set individual targets for the student, providing frequent acknowledgment of achievements across all conditions and for the entirety of each session.
options.C: Use applications to create personalized stories with recorded photos and audio for the student to access across all conditions and for the entirety of each session.
options.D: Include a knee mat and arm splints in subsequent functional analysis sessions, applying these protective procedures noncontingently across all conditions and for the entirety of each session.
